subject: intr
title: (R)INTR.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram closing MP(I)-28 — the section comparing alternative-creative-music continuance with sixties black political activism. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the meta-reality of alternative creativity has, regardless of its route, maintained its constant alignment with the basic tenets of transformational information dynamics. For while I am not in disagreement with the vibrational alignment of western culture, it is clear that the progressional application of western affinity dynamics serves to re-enforce the exclusive position of only western culture, and this position cannot be viewed as "revolutionary" on any level.' The crossing diagrams that constant-alignment structurally: (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance — the actual continuance the form maintains). INTR sits on the left with the subject-arrow; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) rises above-right from the main line, CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) branches from T-C-IMP, and (R)PART (the reality of participation) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) branch from CULT-AF-BS on the right margin. PROG-CONT sits at center-right as partner-axis. LANG-DY (language dynamics) branches down-right from the main line, with IST-F (isolated focus) branching from it. MOT-DY descends from the main line to the lower-left; TR (transformation) branches from MOT-DY, and C-INFO (composite information) branches from TR at the bottom-left.
